headline: Student activity accounts, special education reimbursements and tuition, and budget transfers.
summary: The subcommittee will review student activity accounts, including a new GHS Theatre/Drama account and FY26 activity balances, along with special education items such as FY27 Circuit Breaker Reimbursement, NEC Quarterly Update, out of district tuition, and out of district transportation. The meeting will also cover future meeting arrangements and budget transfers.
